qoe_formula: qoe = visible_quality - alpha * latency_norm - beta * stall_ratio

notes.alpha: Weight on normalized latency penalty (latency_norm = p95_ms / 1000)
notes.beta: Weight on stall ratio penalty (stall_ratio = stall_time / trial_duration)
notes.visible_quality: Fraction of demanded chunks that are visibly complete [0,1]
